items.title: The companies emerging as new leaders in this renewed AI rally
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre examines the comeback seen across the semiconductor landscape over the past five trading days, while also analyzing which companies are emerging as leaders in the renewed AI rally.

items.title: MU, WDC, SKHY, AMD — VanEck’s Nicholas Frasse Downplays Volatility In Semiconductor Stocks, Says Chip Trade Is Still Very Strong

items.title: High Beta Runners Up: Why AMD and Marvell Technology Now Command Attention
items.summary: AMD and Marvell have both crushed earnings while lapping NVIDIA and Broadcom on year-to-date returns, but their strategies for capturing AI infrastructure spending point in completely opposite directions, and only one of them fits every type of investor.

items.title: Why Marvell Technology Stock Fell 37% in July
items.summary: Semiconductor stocks took the brunt of AI spending skepticism.

items.title: Why Marvell (MRVL) Is Up 29.1% After Launching Its New AI Memory Infrastructure Portfolio
items.summary: In early August 2026, Marvell Technology, Inc. unveiled a broad AI memory infrastructure portfolio spanning Bravera SC6 PCIe 6.0 SSD controllers, Structera X CXL-based memory expansion, and Photonic Fabric optical shared-memory solutions to help hyperscalers decouple and scale memory independently from compute for agentic AI inference. By targeting KV cache offload, rack-scale memory pooling, and optical shared memory across racks, Marvell is positioning itself as a key enabler of more...

items.title: Marvell Is Positioned to Absorb a Disproportionate Amount of This AI Capex Surge, So I Keep Buying
items.summary: Hyperscalers are quietly ripping out the networking fabric of every major data center, and one overlooked chipmaker keeps landing the contracts that make that rebuild possible. Here is why every pullback in the stock has become another buying opportunity.

items.title: Who Will Benefit Most From Amazon and Microsoft’s Hyperscaler Leading AI Capex This Quarter?
items.summary: Amazon and Microsoft are burning through roughly $100 billion a quarter on AI infrastructure, and two companies sit directly in that cash flow's path. One just tripled its free cash flow and rallied hard. The other beat on every line and still dropped 12 percent.

items.title: Marvell Stock Amplifies The Market You Already Own
